results.sql: SELECT manufacturer, count FROM top_brands ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT year, avg_price_year FROM price_volume_by_year ORDER BY year LIMIT 100
SELECT state, avg_price FROM geo_distribution ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT condition, count FROM condition_distribution ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(price, 0.5 ORDER BY price) AS median_price FROM mileage_points WHERE manufacturer = 'toyota' AND model = 'camry' LIMIT 100
SELECT model, SUM(count) AS total_listings FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'ford' GROUP BY model ORDER BY total_listings DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT total_vehicles FROM market_stats LIMIT 100
SELECT avg_market_price FROM market_stats LIMIT 100
SELECT MIN(year) AS oldest_year, MAX(year) AS newest_year FROM price_volume_by_year LIMIT 100
SELECT total_brands FROM market_stats LIMIT 100
SELECT state, count FROM geo_distribution ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count FROM geo_distribution WHERE state = 'ca' LIMIT 100
SELECT avg_price FROM geo_distribution WHERE state = 'tx' LIMIT 100
SELECT state, count FROM geo_distribution ORDER BY count ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT count FROM condition_distribution WHERE condition = 'excellent' LIMIT 100
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN condition = 'unknown' THEN count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(count), 2) AS percent_unknown FROM condition_distribution LIMIT 100
SELECT year, volume_year AS listings FROM price_volume_by_year ORDER BY volume_year DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT avg_price_year AS average_price FROM price_volume_by_year WHERE year = 2015 LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(count) AS listings_under_10000 FROM price_histogram WHERE price_range < 10000 LIMIT 100
SELECT price_range, count FROM price_histogram ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT year, avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'ford' AND model = 'f-150' AND year >= 2015 ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(count) AS total_honda_civic_listings FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'honda' AND model = 'civic' LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(odometer) AS avg_odometer FROM mileage_points WHERE manufacturer = 'honda' AND model = 'civic' LIMIT 100

SELECT mp.model, QUANTILE_CONT(mp.price, 0.5 ORDER BY mp.price) AS median_price FROM mileage_points AS mp WHERE mp.manufacturer = 'toyota' GROUP BY mp.model HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN mp.manufacturer = 'toyota' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 100 ORDER BY median_price DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS jeep_model_count FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'jeep' LIMIT 100
SELECT year, avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'chevrolet' AND model = 'corvette' ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT manufacturer AS brand, SUM(avg_price * count) / SUM(count) AS avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year GROUP BY manufacturer HAVING SUM(count) >= 1000 ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'toyota' AND model = 'camry' AND year = 2020) - (SELECT avg_price FROM prices_by_model_year WHERE manufacturer = 'toyota' AND model = 'camry' AND year = 2010) AS price_difference LIMIT 100
SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(odometer, 0.5 ORDER BY odometer) AS median_odometer FROM mileage_points WHERE manufacturer = 'ford' AND model = 'f-150' AND price > 30000 LIMIT 100
